items.title: Solana more than triples transaction size limit with mainnet upgrade
items.summary: Solana raised its transaction size limit to 4,096 bytes, giving developers more room for zero-knowledge proofs and transactions with multiple signatures.

items.title: Bitcoin traders brace for Fed hike, but a surprise hold could pose bigger risk
items.summary: Bitcoin is stuck near $80,000 as traders build stablecoin positions that could return to the market once Fed uncertainty clears.

items.title: Fed meeting is shaping up to be a nightmare for Warsh. Bitcoin might still shine
items.summary: An aggressive market expectations trap and a strict aversion to forward guidance have backed the Fed chair into a corner, where failing to deliver a hawkish message risks destroying the central bank’s inflation-fighting credibility.

items.title: Bitcoin price falls to $75.6K September low as global bonds hit multidecade highs
items.summary: Bitcoin price action weakened over market nerves prior to the Senate CLARITY Act vote, while surging bond yields pressured risk assets across the board.

items.title: Bitcoin Core 32 enters final testing with faster validation, fee changes and security fixes
items.summary: The October update changes how nodes estimate transaction fees and process blocks, while fixing a wallet flaw that could let an authenticated user run commands on a node.

items.title: Bitcoin loses touch with the Dollar Index, U.S. stocks ahead of the Fed
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 16, 2026

items.title: Two Prime makes onchain finance push with $10 million-backed bitcoin yield vault
items.summary: Two Prime expands into onchain finance with a bitcoin lending vault built on Pareto for institutional investors.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450 million as Clarity Act fails
items.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs shed $450 million, the most since June, as the Senate's failure to advance the Clarity Act sent regulatory-sensitive tokens sharply lower.

items.title: Deutsche Bank close to debuting crypto custody for institutions
items.summary: The service will support a select range of cryptocurrencies at debut, including bitcoin and ether and stablecoins like USDC and EURC.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $76,000 as spot ETFs outflows surged alongside Clarity Act failure
items.summary: Privacy token zcash, meanwhile, is up 130% over 30 days and trades near its all-time highs from 2016.

items.title: Circle debuts Arc blockchain which Jeremy Allaire calls ‘more consequential’ than USDC
items.summary: The USDC issuer's chain is built for payments, tokenized assets and institutional finance as banks and payment giants pile into the stablecoin market.

items.title: Bitcoin's Coinbase premium sinks to one-month low, here’s why
items.summary: Weakening U.S. demand, a setback for the Clarity act and expectations of a fed rate hike weigh on bitcoin.

items.title: Two Robinhood engineers charged with insider trading using Hyperliquid perpetuals
items.summary: U.S. prosecutors allege two engineers used confidential Robinhood token listing data to front-run announcements using Hyperliquid perpetual futures.

items.title: Ethereum, Base give up on common wallet standard after months of talks
items.summary: Ethereum is moving ahead with EIP-8141 while Coinbase-backed Base backs EIP-8130, leaving wallets and apps that span both networks facing different transaction systems.

items.title: Zcash holders overwhelmingly back faster transactions and bitcoin-style halvings
items.summary: Nearly 2.4 million ZEC participated, with 99.9% backing 25-second blocks and 98.9% voting to preserve the network’s existing halving schedule.

items.title: Crypto longs worth $570 million wiped out as Clarity Act fails
items.summary: Bullish crypto futures bets worth millions have been liquidated in 24 hours. Bitcoin and ether longs have taken in the most losses.

items.title: XRP sinks 10% as the Clarity Act fails and bitcoin slides toward $76,000
items.summary: The Senate's 49-50 procedural vote left the crypto market structure bill 11 short of what it needed, and every major token fell.

items.title: Zcash holders back 25-second blocks, vote to keep ZEC halving schedule
items.summary: Nearly 99% of ZEC holders voted to reduce block times to 25 seconds, while keeping ZEC issuance and halving schedules unchanged.

items.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet with USDC as native gas token
items.summary: Circle’s Arc mainnet is live with USDC for transaction fees, support for more than 20 fiat stablecoins and links to over 20 blockchains.

items.title: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory nod to launch institutional crypto custody solutions
items.summary: Germany’s largest bank is awaiting regulatory approval to launch institutional custody solutions for Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins before expanding into tokenized assets.
